name: Pocket Sequencer
description: A pocket-synth style face: LCD time, a 16-key step sequencer that lights up with your daily steps, and a playhead running across the keys.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; ['Hour','Colon','Minute'].forEach((nm,i)=>{ project.elements[n-3+i].name = 'Ghost ' + nm; }); return 1
const n = project.elements.length; ['Hour','Colon','Minute'].forEach((nm,i)=>{ project.elements[n-3+i].name = nm + ' Aod'; }); return 1

for (const nm of ['Ghost Hour', 'Ghost Minute']) { const e = project.elements.find((q) => q.name === nm); const eight = e.images[8]; e.images = e.images.map(() => eight); e.glyph = null; e.alpha = 32; e.zero = 1; e.show = 'normal'; } return 1
